archetypes.name: The Resonant Sage
archetypes.expandedDescription:
You feel everything deeply yet stay grounded and calm. Others trust your emotional steadiness.

Your wisdom comes from matching your inner and outer worlds with clarity and authenticity.
archetypes.shadowSide: Can become overly responsible for others' emotions, suppressing their own needs to maintain calm.
archetypes.growthPath: Practice sharing your own emotional needs rather than only supporting others.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A calm guardian carved from shadowed stone, soft light glowing inside their chest, standing alone in a field at dusk, realistic, dark muted palette, subtle inner glow, highly detailed.

archetypes.name: The Soft Anchor
archetypes.description: Gentle, steady, and nurturing in relationships.
archetypes.expandedDescription:
You are gentle, warm, and grounding. People feel safe and comfortable around you.

Your quiet steadiness helps others settle into themselves and feel emotionally supported.
archetypes.shadowSide: May absorb others' feelings so deeply that they lose track of their own boundaries and desires.
archetypes.growthPath: Strengthen boundaries by naming what you need before offering comfort.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A figure sitting on a weathered pier over dark water at sunset, soft light around them, posture relaxed and inviting, semi-realistic, moody but warm atmosphere.

archetypes.name: The Stormbound
archetypes.description: Feels intensely inside but stays guarded and overwhelmed.
archetypes.expandedDescription:
You hold deep emotional intensity beneath the surface, like a quiet storm.

Your challenge is allowing others to witness your depth without retreating.
archetypes.shadowSide: Intensity can become overwhelm; withdrawing into emotional storms creates isolation.
archetypes.growthPath: Let trusted people witness small pieces of your emotional intensity.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A person made of swirling storm clouds, faint lightning under the skin, seated in a dim room, shafts of light from a single window, cinematic realism, dramatic shadows.

archetypes.name: The Truth Teller
archetypes.description: Emotionally aware and radically honest, sometimes too sharp.
archetypes.expandedDescription:
You value honesty and emotional clarity above all else.

Your insight cuts through confusion and encourages real connection.
archetypes.shadowSide: Directness can slip into bluntness, creating conflict or emotional distance.
archetypes.growthPath: Balance honesty with empathy—soften delivery without diluting truth.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A figure speaking into the dark, words forming visible glowing lines in the air, sharp edges of light, high contrast, realistic style with a slightly surreal twist.

archetypes.name: The Open Flame
archetypes.description: Expressive and passionate, quick to feel and show emotions.
archetypes.expandedDescription:
Your emotions are vivid and expressive, lighting up every room you enter.

You create instant connection through openness and authenticity.
archetypes.shadowSide: Emotional impulsivity can burn relationships, leading to misunderstandings or hurt feelings.
archetypes.growthPath: Pause before reacting; channel emotional energy into expression with intention.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A person surrounded by small floating sparks in a dark room, eyes bright, mid-motion as if laughing or talking, warm highlights against deep shadow, expressive realism.

archetypes.name: The Magnetic Poet
archetypes.description: Emotionally articulate, romantic, and deeply sensitive.
archetypes.expandedDescription:
You live in emotional richness and speak in metaphor and meaning.

People are drawn to your depth, sensitivity, and emotional insight.
archetypes.shadowSide: May romanticize pain or over-idealize relationships, making connection feel dramatic or heavy.
archetypes.growthPath: Ground your deep feelings in daily reality and lighten emotional narratives.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A lone figure writing at a desk lit by a single lamp, pages drifting into faint glowing symbols, dark room, rich shadows, painterly realistic style.

archetypes.name: The Mirror Mask
archetypes.description: Reads the room fast and adjusts their emotional display.
archetypes.expandedDescription:
You read emotional environments instantly and adapt to them.

Your social intuition is strong, though your true self deserves more space.
archetypes.shadowSide: Adapting too much can erase personal identity, leaving them unsure who they really are.
archetypes.growthPath: Reveal small authentic truths even when unsure how they will land.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A person holding a half-mirror mask, one eye visible and observant, reflections of other faces in the mask surface, cool tones, realistic with subtle surreal reflections.

archetypes.name: The Boundary Breaker
archetypes.description: Open, intense, and quick to share deeply and directly.
archetypes.expandedDescription:
You connect quickly and deeply, with fearless emotional openness.

You invite intensity and authenticity into relationships.
archetypes.shadowSide: Oversharing too fast can push people away or create unstable intimacy.
archetypes.growthPath: Learn to pace vulnerability and read cues before diving deep.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A person reaching through an open doorway, hand extended in invitation, light spilling through, dramatic shadows and bright highlights, photo-realistic with emotional intensity.

archetypes.name: The Iron Mask
archetypes.description: Keeps emotions private and controlled, appearing steady and composed.
archetypes.expandedDescription:
You keep your emotional world closely guarded, valuing privacy and control.

Underneath your calm exterior lies grounded depth.
archetypes.shadowSide: Emotional walls can become impenetrable, blocking closeness and support.
archetypes.growthPath: Experiment with sharing mild emotions to build trust gradually.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A person wearing a smooth metallic mask standing in misty shadows, arms crossed, posture composed, hints of texture under the surface, muted cool tones, hyperreal.

archetypes.name: The Strategist
archetypes.description: Measured and thoughtful, balancing feeling and thinking.
archetypes.expandedDescription:
You move through emotions with logic and careful thought.

Your steadiness helps you navigate complex emotional situations.
archetypes.shadowSide: Overthinking replaces vulnerability, making relationships feel controlled or distant.
archetypes.growthPath: Replace analysis with presence—try feeling before interpreting.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A figure seated at a chess board in dim light, pieces slightly glowing, thoughtful expression, calm and calculating, realistic but softly lit.

archetypes.name: The Gentle Ghost
archetypes.description: Gentle and withdrawn, seeking calm over confrontation.
archetypes.expandedDescription:
You withdraw when overwhelmed, seeking internal calm.

Your softness is soothing, but your disappearing act confuses others.
archetypes.shadowSide: Avoidance patterns can make others feel shut out or abandoned.
archetypes.growthPath: Stay present for 10 seconds longer when you want to withdraw.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A faint translucent figure standing in fog, barely visible, serene expression, soft light filtering through, pale colors, dreamlike realism.

archetypes.name: The Fortress-Keeper
archetypes.description: Emotionally rich but guarded, protecting their inner world.
archetypes.expandedDescription:
You love with loyalty and strength once trust is earned.

Your emotional world is warm but protected.
archetypes.shadowSide: Strong barriers may keep out support, leaving them lonely or misunderstood.
archetypes.growthPath: Allow safe people gradual entry to your inner world.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A person standing inside a stone fortress with thick walls, light glowing warmly from within, shadows outside, protective but inviting once inside, realistic architecture.

archetypes.name: The Quiet Depth
archetypes.description: Private but emotionally grounded, offering depth to those they trust.
archetypes.expandedDescription:
You offer quiet loyalty and meaningful presence to those you trust.

Your emotional world is selective but rich.
archetypes.shadowSide: Keeping emotions private can lead to missed intimacy or unspoken resentment.
archetypes.growthPath: Communicate your internal world more openly with trusted people.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A person standing at the edge of a still, deep lake at twilight, reflection perfectly mirrored, calm and contemplative, dark muted tones, serene realism.

archetypes.name: The Open Seeker
archetypes.description: Curious and open, exploring emotions and connection.
archetypes.expandedDescription:
You explore emotional landscapes with curiosity and openness.

You thrive on meaningful connection and heartfelt discovery.
archetypes.shadowSide: Chasing emotional novelty may prevent long-term grounding or commitment.
archetypes.growthPath: Focus on deepening existing connections instead of seeking new emotional highs.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A person walking forward on a winding path through clouds, arms slightly outstretched, hopeful expression, soft light ahead, ethereal realism.

archetypes.name: The Tethered Caretaker
archetypes.description: Deeply empathetic and giving, sometimes to their own detriment.
archetypes.expandedDescription:
You care deeply for others, often putting their needs first.

Your empathy is powerful and heartfelt.
archetypes.shadowSide: Over-functioning can lead to burnout and resentment when care is not returned.
archetypes.growthPath: Prioritize self-care first to prevent emotional depletion.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A person helping another person, one figure glowing brightly while tending to the other, their own form slightly faded, warm and compassionate atmosphere, realistic style.

archetypes.name: The Inner Compass
archetypes.description: Balanced and self-aware, navigating emotions with clarity.
archetypes.expandedDescription:
You navigate emotions with balance, clarity, and self-awareness.

People find your presence grounding and trustworthy.
archetypes.shadowSide: Self-reliance can turn into rigidity, resisting help even when needed.
archetypes.growthPath: Invite others to support you, even when you feel steady on your own.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A figure standing in a dark space with a softly glowing compass in their hands, light illuminating their face, calm expression, grounded, hyperreal detail.
